# noust_domain (Resource)

A name an application answers on besides its primary domain: an `alias` that serves the application, or a `redirect` to it. The site is re-rendered and reloaded before the call returns, and when the site serves TLS the certificate is extended to the new name as a job the provider waits for. A certificate that cannot be issued (the name does not point at the server yet) is a warning, not an error: the name is added, and the next apply after the DNS record exists does not need to change it.

The application's primary domain is the `domain` of the `noust_application`, not a resource of this kind.

Needs the permission `apps.manage`; removing a name needs sudo mode.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# www answers on the application too, and an old name sends visitors to it.
resource "noust_domain" "www" {
  app    = noust_application.api.domain
  domain = "www.api.example.com"
}

resource "noust_domain" "legacy" {
  app    = noust_application.api.domain
  domain = "api-old.example.com"
  kind   = "redirect"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) The primary domain of the application. Changing it replaces the name.
- `domain` (String) The name to answer on. Changing it replaces the name.

### Optional

- `check_dns` (Boolean) Whether the server checks that the name points at it before adding it. Default `true`. Only used when the name is added.
- `force` (Boolean) Add the name even though the server refuses it (it resolves elsewhere, or another site holds it). Default `false`. Only used when the name is added.
- `kind` (String) `alias` (serve the application) or `redirect` (send visitors to the primary domain). Default `alias`. Changing it replaces the name.
- `port` (Number) The port of the application this name is proxied to, when it is not the application's own. Updated in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The application's domain and the name, joined with a slash: `app/name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The application's primary domain and the name, joined with a slash.
terraform import noust_domain.www api.example.com/www.api.example.com
```
